services_description: Hum driver ke jeevan ke har pehlu ko support karne ke liye services ka ek poora ecosystem pradaan karte hain.

faq_description: Aapke sawal hain? Hamare paas jawab hain.

faq_list.question: Challan settlement kaise kaam karta hai?
faq_list.answer: Hum aapko legal experts se jodte hain jo Lok Adalat mein aapka pratinidhitv karte hain, jo jald vivaad samadhan ke liye ek sarkari pranali hai.

faq_list.question: Insurance ke liye mujhe kaun se documents chahiye?
faq_list.answer: Aam taur par aapko apna Aadhaar card, PAN card aur gaadi ke registration ki details chahiye.

faq_list.question: Agar mere paas car nahi hai to kya main join kar sakta hoon?
faq_list.answer: Haan, bilkul! Hum un drivers ko job referrals dete hain jinke paas gaadi nahi hai.

faq_list.question: Job referral milne mein kitna time lagta hai?
faq_list.answer: Aapka profile pura hone ke baad, hum aapko 3-5 dinon mein Ola aur Uber jaise partners ke paas refer karte hain.

why_us_section.title: Bharat Sarthi Kyun Chunein?
why_us_section.description: Hum drivers ki samasyaon ko samajhte hain. Hamara platform unhe hal karne ke liye banaya gaya hai.
problems_list: Asthir aay aur naukri ki suraksha ki kami.
Saste swasthya bima ya loan tak pahunch nahi.
Challan jaise jatil kanooni mamlon se nipatne mein kathinai.
Gaadi ki dekhbhal aur parts ki adhik lagat.
Ek sahayak samuday aur margdarshan ki kami.
solutions_list: Pramukh platforms par sthir naukri ke referrals.
Vishesh, kam lagat wale bima aur vitteey utpaad.
Challan ke jaldi niptare ke liye visheshagya sahayata.
Bharosemand, chhoot wale service centers ka network.
